newsitem.title: JAPAN: Three injured in earthquake in southern Japan.
newsitem.headline: Three injured in earthquake in southern Japan.

text.p: Three people were injured when an earthquake measuring 5.5 on the Richter scale rocked Japan's southern island of Kyushu early on Thursday, police said.
The tremor struck Kagoshima Prefecture on Kyushu island at 4.33 a.m. on Thursday (1933 GMT on Wednesday), the Meteorological Agency said.
A police spokesman in Kagoshima said the earthquake injured at least three people, including a nine-year-old boy hit by furniture knocked over by the tremor.
The spokesman said the tremor caused landslides at 10 locations.
